description:
Get a redacted brand

Returns the redacted registration record for brandId within the selected organization. Use this representation to inspect registration state; it does not return every sensitive field originally submitted when the brand was registered. Supply organization_id for the organization that owns the registration.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/10dlc-brands/get-a-redacted-brand
name: getTenDlcBrand

canResubmit.description: Whether a PATCH would now be accepted to fix and resubmit a registration that was not accepted.

editableFields.description: The updateMask paths such a PATCH accepts for this profile type. Empty unless canResubmit.

failureReasons.description: Why the registration was not accepted, while the brand is action_required because of it. PATCH the named fields to fix and resubmit in one request. Empty otherwise.

examples.message: Mobile Phone Number not supported. Must be a Mobile Phone Number that can receive SMS messages.

fields.description: The updateMask paths this reason points at. Empty when it names no single field.

message.description: Why the registration was not accepted.
